title: 补充入参校验并跑测试
turns: 给 divide 加除零校验，并跑 test/calc.test.mjs 验证

seedFiles.content:
import test from "node:test"
import assert from "node:assert"
import { divide } from "../src/calc.mjs"

test("divide", () => assert.equal(divide(6, 2), 3))
test("divide by zero", () => assert.throws(() => divide(1, 0)))
